label: Speciation
text: BI.O.A4.3 Speciation. Lineages cease to exchange genes. Allopatric, parapatric and sympatric routes differ in geography; none is required. Species concepts (biological, phylogenetic, morphological) are naming practice in BI.M.5.

warrant.standard: Phylogeny with support values; congruent independent data
warrant.defeaters: Long-branch attraction; incomplete lineage sorting; horizontal transfer
